description: Logical dm_product_plant — encoded as checker filters/joins (no physical DM table).
source: Confluence Product Plant / Jaroslaw Kochanski; last updated Jun 18, 2025
note: Cluster (SAP_CLUSTER) is also available in all conditions. Grain is material_code + plant_code + sap_cluster. Aggregated sources (MARD, MSLB, MSKU, MCHB, MKOL, CE31000/CE41000, CDHDR) must not add rows. Destination: application_data_quality_ca_data_control_center_golden.dm_product_plant (truncate/insert).

is_basic_scope.note: Published operator is OR. A row is 0 only when (LVORM = 'X' OR MMSTA = '99') AND plant_code is in 4110-4122. This is a DM output attribute. Rules that say is_basic_scope = 1 filter on this flag.

population_filter: After LEFT JOIN plant_code_not_active: keep is_active = 1 OR is_active IS NULL. is_active = 0 drops the plant.

sources.filtering: (PERIO = 0 AND substr(WERKS,1,2) != '49' AND GJAHR = year(sysdate) AND MGTYP = 'ZZ02') OR (PERIO = month(sysdate) AND substr(WERKS,1,2) = '49' AND GJAHR = year(sysdate) AND MGTYP = 'ZZ01')

joins: m LEFT JOIN a1 ON m.MMSTA = a1.MMSTA
m LEFT JOIN a2 ON m.AUSME = a2.MSEHI
m INNER JOIN pcm ON LEFT(m.WERKS,2) = pcm.plant_code_short
m LEFT JOIN a3 ON m.WERKS = a3.WERKS
m LEFT JOIN pcna ON m.WERKS = pcna.plant_code WHERE pcna.is_active = 1 OR pcna.is_active IS NULL
m LEFT JOIN c4 ON m.WERKS = c4.WERKS AND m.MATNR = c4.ARTNR
c4 INNER JOIN c3 ON c4.PAOBJNR = c3.PAOBJNR
m LEFT JOIN mar ON m.WERKS = mar.WERKS AND m.MATNR = mar.MATNR
m LEFT JOIN msl ON m.WERKS = msl.WERKS AND m.MATNR = msl.MATNR
m LEFT JOIN msk ON m.WERKS = msk.WERKS AND m.MATNR = msk.MATNR
m LEFT JOIN mch ON m.WERKS = mch.WERKS AND m.MATNR = mch.MATNR
m LEFT JOIN cp ON m.MATNR = cp.OBJECTID AND cp.TABKEY = '4' + zeros to 25 digits + m.MATNR + m.WERKS (strip spaces inside the number)
cp LEFT JOIN ch ON ch.CHANGENR = cp.CHANGENR
m LEFT JOIN mk ON m.WERKS = mk.WERKS AND m.MATNR = mk.MATNR
m LEFT JOIN ck1 ON m.WERKS = ck1.WERKS AND m.MATNR = ck1.MATNR (after CK1/CK3 aggregation for is_production_version_x_r)
ck1 INNER JOIN ck3 ON ck1.KALNR = ck3.KALNR_BAL AND ck1.SAP_CLUSTER = ck3.SAP_CLUSTER

field_map.sales_quantity_cy: WHEN c3.GJAHR = year(sysdate) THEN sum(c3.ABSMG001) ELSE 0; group by material_code, plant_code, sap_cluster
field_map.sales_quantity_py: WHEN c3.GJAHR = year(sysdate)-1 THEN sum(c3.ABSMG001) ELSE 0
field_map.sales_quantity_ppy: WHEN c3.GJAHR = year(sysdate)-2 THEN sum(c3.ABSMG001) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_unrestricted_quantity_cy: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate) THEN sum(mar.LABST) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_unrestricted_quantity_py: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-1 THEN sum(mar.LABST) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_unrestricted_quantity_ppy: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-2 THEN sum(mar.LABST) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_blocked_quantity_cy: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate) THEN sum(mar.SPEME) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_blocked_quantity_py: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-1 THEN sum(mar.SPEME) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_blocked_quantity_ppy: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-2 THEN sum(mar.SPEME) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_quality_inspection_quantity_cy: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate) THEN sum(mar.INSME) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_quality_inspection_quantity_py: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-1 THEN sum(mar.INSME) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_quality_inspection_quantity_ppy: WHEN mar.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-2 THEN sum(mar.INSME) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_vendor_flag: IF any msl row THEN 'X' ELSE ''
field_map.stock_vendor_quantity: sum(msl.LBLAB + msl.LBINS + msl.LBVLA + msl.LBVIN + msl.LBEIN + msl.LBVEI)
field_map.stock_customer_unrestricted_use_quantity: WHEN msk.LFGJA = year(sysdate) THEN sum(msk.KULAB) ELSE 0
WHEN msk.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-1 THEN sum(msk.KULAB) ELSE 0
WHEN msk.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-2 THEN sum(msk.KULAB) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_batch_cy: WHEN mch.LFGJA = year(sysdate) THEN sum(mch.CLABS + mch.CSPEM) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_batch_py: WHEN mch.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-1 THEN sum(mch.CLABS + mch.CSPEM) ELSE 0
field_map.stock_batch_ppy: WHEN mch.LFGJA = year(sysdate)-2 THEN sum(mch.CLABS + mch.CSPEM) ELSE 0
field_map.is_basic_scope: IF (LVORM <> 'X' AND MMSTA <> '99') OR plant_code NOT IN (4110-4122) THEN '1' ELSE '0'
field_map.stock_supplier_quantity: sum(mk.SLABS+mk.SINSM+mk.SEINM+mk.SSPEM+mk.SVMLA+mk.SVMIN+mk.SVMEI+mk.SVMSP); 0 if no rows. Aggregate before join.
field_map.is_production_version_x_r: IF any ck3.VERID_ND LIKE 'R%' OR LIKE 'X%' for material_code/plant_code THEN '1' ELSE ''
